title: Strawberry polytunnel T8 (10 min, Monash CC BY 4.0)
summary: In this 10 minute survey of 18 flowers the only visitors seen were honeybees with 6 insects making 8 visits. Only 5 of 18 flowers were visited in that time but the numbers are too small to conclude much about overall coverage. A practical next step is to repeat longer watches at different times of day over several days.
